hero.step1Title: Orientative tone test · Step 1 of 3: undertone and depth
hero.step1Description: Discover your undertone and depth with this simple visual guide. Answer a few key questions or pick your swatches to explore compatible bases and correctors in our multibrand catalog.
hero.step2Title: Orientative tone test · Step 2 of 3: preferences and coverage
hero.step2Description: Adjust coverage, finish and focus to orient the suggestions of bases and correctors in the multibrand catalog.
hero.step3Description: We cross-referenced your undertone with your finish and coverage preferences to show orientative options from the multibrand catalog.

step1.selectorHint: Pick the undertone that best describes how your skin looks in natural daylight:

warm.label: Warm / Golden
warm.hint: If your skin shows golden or yellow nuances, this is an orientative starting point.

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.hint: A balance between pink and warm nuances: a versatile reference across bases and brands.

cool.label: Cool / Pink
cool.hint: If your skin shows pink or violet nuances, this is an orientative starting point.

step1.shadeHint: Brand-color swatches to orient the intensity of your tone:
step1.summaryText: An orientative guide to explore compatible bases and correctors in the next steps.
step1.questionsHint: Answer according to how your skin looks and feels without any product on.
step1.question1: 1. How does your skin react to summer sun?
step1.question2: 2. Which finish do you prefer day to day?
step1.question4: 4. How is your skin through the day?

fast.label: I burn easily
fast.hint: I turn red and barely tan

step1.tipText: If you often use tinted sunscreen or self-tanner, you can adjust your usual depth in step 2.
step1.dockText: A practical guide to orient yourself among the brands in our multibrand catalog.
step1.dockCta: Continue to step 2: preferences and coverage

step2.coverageTitle: Which coverage level are you looking for every day?

light.label: Light skin tint
light.hint: Evens out subtly without covering freckles or natural texture.

medium.label: Buildable medium coverage
medium.hint: Softens redness and small marks by building layers.

full.label: Full coverage
full.hint: An even canvas with long wear.

step2.focusTitle: Focus you want to address today
step2.rangeText: Suggestions adapt to both ends of the range you selected.
step2.summaryText: Guidance based on catalog formulas. The next step shows your orientative selection.
step2.disclaimer: trino. orientative guide: tones vary according to each brand's formula.
step2.bannerText: We cross your coverage, finish and undertone preferences with formulas from the catalog.

step3.title: Here are your suggestions
step3.description: We cross-referenced your undertone with your preferences to show orientative options from the catalog.
step3.tipText: Try a small amount on the side of your neck in natural light to see how the formula settles on your skin.
step3.curationSubtitle: Selection based on your finish preferences
step3.curationQuote: For a warm golden undertone with a glow finish, buildable light bases and peach blushes enhance natural luminosity without overloading the skin.
step3.curationCardText: An orientative selection based on your answers: you can mix textures and depths until you find the routine you like.
step3.curationAdvice: Apply a thin layer, check it in natural light and adjust the intensity to your taste.
